integrity: The endpoint formulas and inequality are proved exactly. The included computation is only a finite corroborative replay and is not used to infer the infinite statement. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result is an endpoint obstruction to Conjecture 5.1(II)(1) as stated in arXiv:2609.32450v1. It does not settle the conjectured ordering for interior type-(1) pairs, nor any corrected version that excludes the distinguished endpoint pair.
title: Endpoint obstruction to the proposed Lagrange-constant phase transition
